title: Constitution of Pakistan — Article 140A
category: Civic governance / local government constitutional framework
text: Constitution of Pakistan — Article 140A. Constitutional basis requiring each province to establish a local-government system and devolve political, administrative and financial responsibility and authority to elected local governments. Use as high-level context; operational responsibilities come from provincial/local legislation. Official source: Pakistan Code / Constitution.
